description: This file contains automated tests for the Playwright browser screenshot functionality, including various test cases for viewport, element, fullPage, and type options, as well as output directory handling and error conditions.

methods.name: browser_take_screenshot (viewport)
methods.description: Test case for taking a screenshot of the viewport.

methods.name: browser_take_screenshot (element)
methods.description: Test case for taking a screenshot of a specific element.

methods.name: --output-dir should work
methods.description: Verifies that the output directory is created and contains the correct screenshot file.

methods.name: browser_take_screenshot (type: png)
methods.description: Test for specifying different image types (png, jpeg) during screenshot.

methods.name: browser_take_screenshot (default type should be png)
methods.description: Verifies default image type is PNG when not specified.

methods.name: browser_take_screenshot (filename is empty string)
methods.description: Test the behavior when filename argument is an empty string.

methods.name: browser_take_screenshot (filename: "output.png")
methods.description: Test the behavior when filename argument is a specific filename.

methods.name: browser_take_screenshot (imageResponses=omit)
methods.description: Verify behavior when image responses are omitted as per configuration.

methods.name: browser_take_screenshot (fullPage: true)
methods.description: Test for capturing full page screenshots.

methods.name: browser_take_screenshot size cap
methods.description: Test for ensuring screenshot size limits and correct dimensions for different page sizes and formats.

methods.name: browser_take_screenshot (fullPage with element should error)
methods.description: Verify error is thrown when fullPage and element screenshot are used together.

methods.name: browser_take_screenshot (viewport without snapshot)
methods.description: Test taking a viewport screenshot without a prior snapshot (no navigation).
